page.notes: The Greek marginal notes in the right margin are cut off at the edge of the scan and can only be partly seen; they are marked as illegible. The first letter of the paragraph beginning "IMpudentiam" is a large initial, joined to its word. The first line of the page begins mid-sentence and is marked cont="true". The printed "uero" and "urbes" are changed to v per the spelling rule. Greek throughout; most of the strip is small, cramped and partly worn, so many words carry [?]. The line "ἀδμα." and the forms after "ὡς" are doubtful. The spaced "N AI-" line is read as a heading. The strip shows the right-hand edge of the text, so line-ends are cut and short lines are not clearly paragraph ends; paragraph breaks are a best reading.
